definition_en: A relation involving location, arrangement, route, contact, or physical force.
A place specified relative to a reference space.
A location defined by being within or beyond an enclosing boundary.
A spatial divider that marks where a region ends.
A position determined by a figure's extent or limits.
A place specified using a direction, axis, or viewpoint.
A region located with respect to two bounding references.
A measurable or perceptible separation or opening between entities.
A spatial configuration or geometric property of surfaces, lines, entities, or body parts.
A route or cross-region relation, whether static or traversed.
A relation of immediate nearness or surface meeting.
A force or bodily-stability relation that resists displacement.
